summary.text: In June 2026 remarks at an AWS summit, CIA Director John Ratcliffe said he made emerging technologies a top CIA priority alongside China. Ratcliffe described frontier AI models’ capabilities as akin to “digital nuclear weapons” in conversations with national security and economic advisors. He said the CIA cannot wait for a risk-free approach to emerging technology and must move fast and aggressively to master it better than adversaries. Ratcliffe said widespread AI adoption is transforming how the agency does business and that AI advances are rewriting conflict, with implications for U.S. strategic advantage and national security.
